info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Airline Flights Baggages-v4-spec
info.description: The Airline Baggage Information API enables users to access detailed data regarding airline flights and their associated baggage. This endpoint allows consumers, such as travel agencies and logistics companies, to fetch baggage information linked to specific flights efficiently. Users can utilize this data to enhance customer service, streamline operations, and improve baggage handling processes. The API ensures that stakeholders have real-time access to vital baggage details, facilitating informed decision-making and operational efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed baggage information associated with specific flights, including weight limits, fees, and policies. Use this resource to ensure compliance with airline regulations and provide the best service to travelers.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information regarding baggage for flights. It should include necessary parameters related to the flight or passenger details to ensure accurate baggage retrieval.

ListAirlineFlightsBaggagesRequest.description: This schema represents the JSON string format for the request body when retrieving baggage information related to flights. This is expected to be a string value.
